purpose: production direction only: does not assert all specified assets or mechanics exist in Unreal

realms.signature: The Unanswered Interval: bell without a last note
realms.landscape: Roads stitched through contradictory maps, refugee lanterns and a split-record archive.
realms.main_question: Can an unrecorded refuge and an officially documented truth both be real?
main_verbs: Ring the silent bell and mark two observable landmarks
Carry supplies through the contested neighborhood and speak to local witnesses
Choose shelter or research testimony with a clear permanent preview
realms.mechanism: Place evidence against the bell sound in Bellwold; compare the absence in Paperhaven without fabricating either account.
realms.danger: Moving routes and civic access; neither path is a combat-only choke.
realms.care: Preserve public shelter access and lantern use.
realms.truth: Make the missing record inspectable without forcefully identifying every protected resident.
realms.ability: Witnesscraft identifies firsthand testimony; Living Roads opens earned community paths.
realms.foreshadow: Bell silence is later heard in rain, fire and choir; never say Nhal-Vey here.
realms.return: A stranger can trace both shelter and archive routes, meeting residents who remember the chosen side.
realms.held: The road gains a visible scar through existing public landmarks.
realms.many: The same street has two navigable, clearly signposted interpretations.
realms.test: Choose both paths on separate saves; reload preserves route and individual witness memories.

realms.signature: Missing water as an economic and environmental absence
realms.landscape: Dry docks under persistent rain, wet ledgers, hollow ship-roof shelters.
realms.main_question: Who owns the proof of a sea that no longer exists?
main_verbs: Collect a shoreline impression from a physical pier and a contradictory wet map
Avoid a telegraphed tidal storm pulse and use an elevated safe route
Commit to public rain access or a protected account of loss
realms.mechanism: Weather counter, rain sluice and hand-operated storm break; unique audio pulse warns before damage.
realms.danger: Rain-lane pulses, with legible blue warning and a reliable dry shelter.
realms.care: Shelter ferry users without requiring old ownership papers.
realms.truth: Preserve the ledger and collateral history without declaring private survivors debtors.
realms.enemy: Rainward tide hazard; local story guardian remains optional
realms.ability: Cartography distinguishes mapped and personally verified crossing; Tomorrow Debt offers risky short-term action.
realms.foreshadow: A missing tide is dated like a loan due before birth.
realms.return: Storm records update to acknowledge actual Rainward public choice; no generic all-knowing NPC reaction.
realms.held: The missing coast retains the last honest tide mark.
realms.many: Two differently timed shoreline marks remain readable together.
realms.test: A player can walk the storm safe line, save/reload and still inspect both evidence perspectives.

realms.signature: An impossible sun's heat and shared physical obligations
realms.landscape: Inward mountain city with public kilns, soot families and thermal canal controls.
realms.main_question: Who pays to keep an unowned flame alive?
main_verbs: Trace a heat canal from the common kiln to a cold household
Manually divert a heat pulse through an insulated channel
Balance immediate warmth for children against truth about inherited fuel costs
realms.mechanism: Two-channel furnace valve and heat-shutter pair; show actual pipe change and temperature field.
realms.danger: Timed heat pulses with stable visual rim and cooled recovery window.
realms.care: Keep unregistered homes warm without demanding signatures.
realms.truth: Expose the true provenance of fuel and require a public repair plan.
realms.enemy: Kiln-hazard encounter, not an arbitrary fire monster
realms.ability: Oathbinding ties explicit promises to a measurable heat benefit; Legacy Forging records a genuine deed.
realms.foreshadow: Flames lack exactly the same note missing from the Reach's bell.
realms.return: Citizens relight hearths based on the route player actually maintained.
realms.held: Two shadows belong to one common flame.
realms.many: Twin embers suggest coexisting origins without doubling resources.
realms.test: Valve visibly directs heat, hazard has readable counterplay, old community decision survives.

realms.signature: Contracts dated before their signers' birth
realms.landscape: Tide clocks in stranded boats, ferry passages and flooded civic ledgers.
realms.main_question: Who can pledge a tomorrow for someone not yet born?
main_verbs: Examine ferry receipt and collateral tide impressions on opposite routes
Work a debt latch to open a permanent physical care or truth bridge
Return for an Echo investigation and optional two-rite observatory
realms.danger: Ledger tide lanes with visible warning and cover; don't demand repeated debt farming.
realms.care: Make a child-safe ferry that never charges future passengers.
realms.truth: Publish verifiable fraud without forcibly identifying protected borrowers.
realms.enemy: Collector of Unborn Days, optional witnessed guardian
realms.ability: Tomorrow Debt + Oathbinding opens calendar observatory only after completed Echo.
realms.foreshadow: The ledger implies the world has been taking loans against nonexistent histories.
realms.return: Local residents remember ferry or archive outcomes, guardian mercy or defeat, and observatory archive.
realms.held: The estuary's promises are carved into visible stable dates.
realms.many: Two future and past receipts are presented side by side, not merged into one.
realms.test: First-quest two routes, aftermath, Echo, optional guardian, optional dual-rite door independently survive reload.

realms.signature: Songs physically holding inverted architecture aloft
realms.landscape: Hanging neighborhoods and two load-bearing musical support scores.
realms.main_question: Can you give silenced people a voice without dropping the homes they support?
main_verbs: Observe the actual support-counterweight under a precarious building
Tune the fork to a recorded note while keeping an alternate stable load
Choose shared meter or public excluded chorus, and see the hanging path respond
realms.danger: Inverted gravity stress pulse with anchored safe walkway, horizon remains stable in accessibility mode.
realms.care: Stabilize homes through a voluntary shared support rhythm.
realms.truth: Recover forbidden singers' names without forcing their return to compulsory work.
realms.enemy: Missing Chorister, optional guardian with audible pre-strike cadence
realms.ability: Unwrite Law + Paradox Convergence opens paired supporting-harmony observatory.
realms.foreshadow: The exact missing musical rest is identical to the Unanswered Interval.
realms.return: A household's safety and a dissenting score remain independently inspectable.
realms.held: All public music includes the erased staff line.
realms.many: Two supporting harmonies can be seen without doubling the actual load.
realms.test: Play both notes without instant collision, examine witnesses and verify chosen physical route remains.

realms.signature: Erased families compressed into history-bearing stone
realms.landscape: Quarry seams, ancestor mortar, rail braces and fossil family portraits.
realms.main_question: Can the city keep its homes without treating an ancestor as quarry material?
main_verbs: Read alternate ancestral inscriptions from two sides of a geological cut
Place a seam clamp or named brace that changes collision-supported access
Test a dangerous rock lane after its visible fracture warning
realms.danger: Pressure seam collapse with widening crack telegraph and a safe sidestep.
realms.care: Preserve accessible braced route and shelter without another erased generation.
realms.truth: Display a public family record of the quarry's origin with informed consent.
realms.ability: Legacy Forging + Understanding Bosses opens named-provenance observatory.
realms.foreshadow: The name sealed in mortar is not simply old: it belongs to an event removed from recorded chronology.
realms.return: Repair homes using explicitly sourced materials while keeping the earlier choice visible.
realms.held: Stone names cut from history remain engraved and legible.
realms.many: Old and living genealogies appear on overlapping but separable walls.
realms.test: Source and materials must remain causal; do not pretend a character can be restored by clicking a monument.

realms.signature: People without official beginnings whose consent matters
realms.landscape: Doorways without census numbers, shelters behind name latches and voluntary public thresholds.
realms.main_question: Can someone exist without owing their identity to the city?
main_verbs: Open a private shelter without entering a guest's name
Examine an official recognition board and a hidden shelter without merging their records
Work an identity latch in the ethical direction supported by the witnesses
realms.danger: Name-scan lane warns before an identity pulse; silence and physical shielding can avoid it.
realms.care: Shelter stays reachable without public identity disclosure.
realms.truth: Public recognition is opt-in and revocable, not a forced population dump.
realms.ability: Witnesscraft + Borrowed Lives opens consent-bounded testimony observatory.
realms.foreshadow: Unregistered residents prove that absence and nonexistence are not the same.
realms.return: A previously hidden resident chooses whether to speak; never auto-publish a name.
realms.held: Quiet houses remain visibly legitimate civic destinations.
realms.many: Private refuge and public threshold coexist with voluntary traversal.
realms.test: No gameplay branch can reveal an individual's identity without its explicit recorded consent.

realms.signature: Unwritten laws growing from living roots
realms.landscape: Root courts, communal fruit stores, roads grafted from consent and a physically empty throne.
realms.main_question: How does a court keep enforcing a law nobody approved?
main_verbs: Compare a shared graft to evidence of an empty coronation
Turn a root-channel control to build one permanent walkable civic road
Question the untitled court about a legal mandate with no author
realms.danger: Roots point at the lane before a timed strike; alternate public path offers counterplay.
realms.care: Share the road and harvest without an inherited crown.
realms.truth: Expose the unratified court law while preserving living people's right to dissent.
realms.ability: Living Roads + Oathbinding opens public arboretum archives.
realms.foreshadow: The first legal rule was never signed; an answering mechanism continued enforcing it anyway.
realms.return: Roots remember elected access and old disputes instead of being magically healed.
realms.held: Public harvest shares its path with a visibly empty crown.
realms.many: Two readable competing laws remain open to civil challenge.
realms.test: Change root traversal collision after choice, preserve archive and access, never create an invisible monarch.

realms.signature: Two truthful beginnings at one usable threshold
realms.landscape: Doorways without foundations, contradictory source maps, stable return line and northern final arena.
realms.main_question: Why did the world make a consciousness to eat unanswered questions?
main_verbs: Read both stable-memory and contradictory-map evidence before choosing an origin anchor
Open one real threshold with stable fallback travel
Confront Nhal-Vey's mask, unveiled form, and deliberate future-choice controls
realms.danger: Origin distortions, safe marked return; boss has four directional attacks with real windups.
realms.care: Reliable passage exists without erasing other origins.
realms.truth: Both maps remain inspectable without one mandatory universal history.
realms.enemy: Nhal-Vey, two required boss forms, then optional post-ending echo; Unfinished Witness optional guardian
realms.ability: Unwrite Law + Cartography opens optional safe-mapping observatory; not needed to finish.
realms.foreshadow: Reveal that Nhal-Vey suppresses questions; don't reveal false-victory twist during ordinary traversal.
realms.return: Held Morning uses bell/names echo attacks; Many Mornings uses horizon/counterfactual echoes.
realms.held: Auvren's threshold keeps one visibly reliable exit after victory.
realms.many: Two contradictory dawns appear while a stable exit remains.
realms.test: Main story reaches boss without sidequest grind; save preserves identity and all choices through both endings and optional rematch.
